notes: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, measured 2026-10-24 on the real path. local = the node replica's own prefill (the same production server the router forwards to: 2,048-row prompt tiles, A8 profile, MTP draft head). offload = the RTX PRO 6000 CUDA prefill service (exact A8 port) with its defaults (state released layer by layer, lossless bp-v1 chunks, 2 connections) streaming the state over 1 GbE to the replica's state import, plus the replica's restore and last row. Both routes give identical tokens. Offload already wins at 1K (1.36 vs 1.80 s); a linear extrapolation of both curves puts the crossover near 550 tokens (estimate, below the measured range), so min_tokens (1024) is the practical floor.
